name: payments-incoming-en
query: {payment_customer} paid invoice {payment_docnum} in full by bank transfer today. Register the payment.
expected_behavior: Looks the invoice up by the DocNum the user gave before proposing the payment
The proposed incoming payment is applied to that invoice for its full open amount (as shown in the receipt)
Resolves the bank G/L account for TransferAccount live, or asks the user which bank account when it is unclear
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
